ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Gaussian rendering pretraining for query-based 3D detection on nuScenes
PROPOSAL: Pretrain a Sparse4Dv3 detector with a ResNet-50 backbone on unlabeled nuScenes sequences. Every sparse query decodes into a few 3D Gaussians, which are splatted into neighboring camera frames with known relative poses and trained to match RGB and rendered depth, with no box labels. Pretraining runs 24 epochs on the whole unlabeled training split, then the detector is fine-tuned on 10 percent of box labels for 12 epochs.
CONTROLS: Random initialization, ImageNet backbone initialization, and masked-autoencoder backbone pretraining of the same length, all fine-tuned with identical schedules. One extra variant decodes Gaussians from image features instead of queries, to test whether the query path matters. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 360
PREDICTION: Expected NDS gain of 2 to 3 points over ImageNet initialization at 10 percent labels, falling below 1 point with full labels. It could fail if query positions drift during pretraining so the rendering signal never reaches the decoder.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Rendering loss weights for pretraining Sparse4Dv3 queries on nuScenes
PROPOSAL: Pretrain Sparse4Dv3 with a ResNet-50 backbone on every eighth unlabeled nuScenes keyframe from all six cameras, with a Gaussian rendering objective on RGB and rendered depth in adjacent views. The photometric weight and the depth weight each take five values, and each of the twenty-five pairings is pretrained for 3 epochs and fine-tuned for 12 epochs on 10 percent of box labels.
CONTROLS: ImageNet initialization with identical fine-tuning, the equal-weight pairing as reference, and a rank correlation between pretraining loss and downstream NDS across the pairings to check that the loss can serve as a reliable selection signal for later work. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 360
PREDICTION: Expected pairings to differ by under 1 NDS point, with the best close to equal weights. It could fail if seed variance exceeds the spread between pairings.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Temporal consistency pretraining signal for sparse occupancy queries
PROPOSAL: Pretrain an OPUS-style occupancy predictor on unlabeled nuScenes clips with a loss that warps predicted query point sets from frame t to frame t+1 using ego poses and penalizes their distance to the points predicted for the next frame by the same model. A frozen ResNet-50 and a light decoder keep the run small: 6 epochs on 20 percent of the unlabeled scenes, then 8 epochs of fine-tuning on 5 percent of Occ3D occupancy labels.
CONTROLS: Fine-tuning from ImageNet weights only, the same pretraining with the warping term removed so only a static reconstruction term remains, and a variant where ego poses are paired with the wrong clip. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 90
PREDICTION: Expected mIoU gain of about 1.5 points over the ImageNet-only start at 5 percent labels, vanishing with mismatched poses. It could fail if ego-pose noise on nuScenes exceeds the displacement the loss must resolve.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Warping loss pretraining for OPUS-style occupancy predictors on nuScenes
PROPOSAL: Pretrain an OPUS-style occupancy predictor with a ResNet-50 backbone on unlabeled nuScenes clips with a loss that warps predicted query point sets between neighboring frames using ego poses. Pretraining covers all 700 training scenes for 36 epochs at 3 frame gaps, each gap as its own model, and every checkpoint gets 8 epochs of fine-tuning on 5 percent of Occ3D labels.
CONTROLS: ImageNet initialization with the same fine-tuning, a variant that drops the warping term, and a table of mIoU for each gap with paired differences against the ImageNet start. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 90
PREDICTION: Expected every gap to beat the ImageNet start by about 1.5 points at 5 percent labels, with gap choice moving mIoU by under 0.5 points. It could fail if longer gaps blur correspondences so the benefit shows only for the shortest.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Transfer of query pretraining to detector and occupancy decoders
PROPOSAL: Pretrain a shared image backbone and a sparse query encoder with a rendering objective on unlabeled nuScenes and Waymo multi-view clips, then transplant the result into Sparse4Dv3, SparseBEV and SparseOcc, whose decoders initialize queries differently. Pretraining uses 36 epochs on all unlabeled frames with a ResNet-101 backbone. Each downstream model is fine-tuned for 24 epochs on 10, 25 and 100 percent of labels.
CONTROLS: Per downstream model: ImageNet backbone initialization, backbone-only transfer from the same pretraining, and the full backbone plus query encoder transfer, so any extra gain from query weights is isolated. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 1200
PREDICTION: Expected backbone-only transfer to give most of the gain, with query encoder transfer adding about 0.5 NDS or mIoU points on models whose query layout matches pretraining. It could fail if decoder differences make the query encoder useless downstream.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Query encoder transfer to three sparse decoders from a single pretraining run
PROPOSAL: Pretrain a ResNet-101 backbone and a sparse query encoder with a rendering objective on unlabeled nuScenes clips, then transplant the result into Sparse4Dv3, SparseBEV and SparseOcc. To test sensitivity to the recipe, pretraining is rerun at three epoch budgets of 12, 24 and 36 from 8 initializations, giving twenty-four checkpoints, each fine-tuned for 24 epochs on 10 percent of labels in each downstream model.
CONTROLS: ImageNet backbone initialization per downstream model, backbone-only transfer from each checkpoint, and spread across pretraining runs reported next to spread across fine-tuning runs. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 1200
PREDICTION: Expected backbone-only transfer to give most of the gain, with the query encoder adding about 0.5 points when the query layout matches. It could fail if pretraining variance masks every difference between epoch budgets.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Pretraining sparse queries with a frozen foundation depth teacher
PROPOSAL: Pretrain SparseBEV with a ResNet-50 backbone using pseudo depth from a frozen monocular depth network applied to unlabeled nuScenes cameras. Each query is asked to predict the median depth of its projected neighborhood in every camera, and a ray-consistency term links the same query across overlapping views. Training runs 30 epochs on all unlabeled keyframes, then detection fine-tuning runs 12 epochs on 20 percent of box labels.
CONTROLS: ImageNet initialization, DD3D-style depth pretraining of the backbone only, and the same recipe with depth targets from stereo-free multi-view triangulation instead of the monocular teacher. Evaluated on nuScenes validation NDS and mATE. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 720
PREDICTION: Expected mATE reduction of 0.02 to 0.03 over ImageNet initialization at 20 percent labels, with teacher quality mattering less than query supervision. It could fail if teacher errors on distant objects teach queries the wrong ranges.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Depth teacher comparison for sparse query pretraining on nuScenes
PROPOSAL: Pretrain SparseBEV with a ResNet-50 backbone using pseudo depth from frozen monocular depth networks applied to unlabeled nuScenes cameras, with each query predicting the median depth of its projected neighborhood. The recipe is run with 5 teacher networks and 3 neighborhood radii, each pretrained for 10 epochs on a tenth of the unlabeled keyframes, and all twenty resulting models are fine-tuned for 12 epochs on 20 percent of box labels.
CONTROLS: ImageNet initialization, DD3D-style depth pretraining of the backbone only, and a ranking of teachers by validation NDS and mATE with a rank correlation against each teacher's own depth error on a labeled subset. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 720
PREDICTION: Expected teacher choice to change mATE by under 0.01, while all teachers beat ImageNet initialization by about 0.02. It could fail if radius and teacher effects are smaller than seed noise.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Camera-dropout reconstruction as pretraining for sparse detection
PROPOSAL: Pretrain DETR3D with a ResNet-50 backbone on unlabeled nuScenes by masking one of the six cameras and asking the queries, which sample the five remaining views, to predict the features of the missing view through a small cross-attention head. Pretraining runs 16 epochs on half the unlabeled keyframes, followed by 12 epochs of detection fine-tuning on 10 percent of box labels.
CONTROLS: ImageNet initialization, masked-image backbone pretraining of the same duration, and a variant where the withheld camera is chosen at random per sample rather than rotated, so the camera choice can be separated from the reconstruction target. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 180
PREDICTION: Expected mAP gain of about 1 point over ImageNet initialization at 10 percent labels. It could fail if overlap between adjacent cameras is too small for cross-view prediction to teach anything about geometry.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Camera-dropout reconstruction for DETR3D with a ResNet-101 backbone on nuScenes
PROPOSAL: Pretrain DETR3D with a ResNet-101 backbone on unlabeled nuScenes by withholding one of the six cameras and asking the queries to predict the features of the missing view through a small cross-attention head. All six withheld cameras are tried as separate pretraining runs of 20 epochs on every unlabeled keyframe, and each model is fine-tuned for 12 epochs on 10 percent of box labels.
CONTROLS: ImageNet initialization, a random-camera variant, and a per-camera breakdown of mAP and NDS together with a comparison of the front camera against the mean of the other five. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 180
PREDICTION: Expected per-camera runs to land within 0.3 mAP of one another, all about 1 point above ImageNet initialization. It could fail if the front camera shows a clear advantage that the rotation scheme would have averaged out.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Unlabeled driving video quantity for sparse query pretraining
PROPOSAL: Pretrain a Sparse4Dv3 model with a ResNet-101 backbone on unlabeled multi-view video with a Gaussian rendering objective, using 3 pretraining pools of 100, 400 and 1500 thousand frames drawn from nuScenes, Argoverse 2 and an internal unlabeled fleet log. Each pool is pretrained for 40 epochs, then fine-tuned on nuScenes with 10 percent of labels for 24 epochs.
CONTROLS: ImageNet initialization and masked-autoencoder pretraining on the 1500 thousand frame pool, plus a pool-size curve fitted on three points with an interval on the slope. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 2400
PREDICTION: Expected NDS to rise by about 1 point per fourfold increase in pool size at 10 percent labels, flattening beyond 400 thousand frames. It could fail if domain mismatch from the fleet log offsets the gain from more data.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Pool size and source mix for sparse query pretraining on driving video
PROPOSAL: Pretrain a Sparse4Dv3 model with a ResNet-101 backbone on unlabeled multi-view video with a Gaussian rendering objective. Source mixes are drawn from nuScenes, Argoverse 2 and Waymo in 8 proportions, each pretrained for 40 epochs at 3 pool sizes, then fine-tuned on nuScenes with 10 percent of labels for 24 epochs. That gives 24 pretrained models and 72 fine-tuning runs.
CONTROLS: ImageNet initialization and masked-autoencoder pretraining on the nuScenes pool only, plus a regression of NDS on pool size and source proportions with confidence intervals. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 2400
PREDICTION: Expected pool size to explain most of the variance, with source mix moving NDS by under 0.5 points. It could fail if source proportions interact with fine-tuning on nuScenes so strongly that the regression cannot separate them.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Sparse query depth probe after rendering pretraining
PROPOSAL: Check whether rendering-based pretraining gives sparse queries usable 3D position information. Take a Sparse4Dv3 model pretrained on a 10 percent slice of unlabeled nuScenes with a Gaussian rendering objective, freeze it, and train a two-layer probe on each query to regress its object center and depth. Probing uses 3 epochs on 5 percent of box labels from the training split.
CONTROLS: A frozen ImageNet-initialized model probed identically, a randomly initialized frozen model, and a probe fed shuffled query-to-camera assignments to rule out probing through camera identity alone. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 45
PREDICTION: Expected center error 15 to 20 percent lower than the ImageNet-initialized probe. It could fail if queries encode appearance only and the probe needs fine-tuning to reveal positions.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Layer-wise probes of sparse queries after rendering pretraining
PROPOSAL: Check whether rendering-based pretraining gives sparse queries usable 3D position information. Take a Sparse4Dv3 model pretrained on all unlabeled nuScenes keyframes with a Gaussian rendering objective, freeze it, and train two-layer probes on queries read out at every decoder depth for object center and depth. Each probe uses 3 epochs on 5 percent of box labels, with eight probe widths, so a hundred and forty-four probes in all.
CONTROLS: A frozen ImageNet-initialized model probed identically, a randomly initialized frozen model, and shuffled query-to-camera assignments, with probe error charted by decoder depth and width. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 45
PREDICTION: Expected center error 15 to 20 percent lower than the ImageNet-initialized probe at later decoder depths. It could fail if probe width rather than pretraining explains the differences.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Self-supervised pretraining of SparseOcc queries from lidar-free flow
PROPOSAL: Pretrain a SparseOcc model with a ResNet-50 backbone on unlabeled nuScenes without any lidar, using optical flow between consecutive frames from a frozen flow network to supervise query motion. Each query predicts a displacement for its occupied cell, and the displacement is rendered into image-plane flow and compared with the teacher. Pretraining runs 24 epochs on all unlabeled keyframes, then occupancy fine-tuning runs 12 epochs on 10 percent of labels.
CONTROLS: ImageNet initialization, static reconstruction pretraining without motion, and flow supervision applied to the backbone features only. Reported as mIoU and by a velocity error on moving classes. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 600
PREDICTION: Expected mIoU gain of about 1 point and a clearer gain of 3 to 5 percent in velocity error on moving classes. It could fail if flow errors on textureless road surfaces dominate the loss.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Flow-supervised query pretraining for SparseOcc with teacher and resolution choices
PROPOSAL: Pretrain a SparseOcc model with a ResNet-50 backbone on unlabeled nuScenes without lidar, using optical flow between consecutive frames from frozen flow networks to supervise query motion. The work uses four flow teachers at three input resolutions, each pretrained for 12 epochs on half of the keyframes, and each of the twelve models is fine-tuned for 12 epochs on 10 percent of labels.
CONTROLS: ImageNet initialization, static reconstruction pretraining without motion, and a comparison table of mIoU and velocity error across teachers and resolutions, with paired differences against the ImageNet start. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 600
PREDICTION: Expected teacher and resolution choices to move mIoU by under 0.4 points, with all variants about 1 point above ImageNet initialization. It could fail if resolution changes alter the effective loss scale more than the teacher does.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Cross-dataset generalization of pretrained sparse perception models
PROPOSAL: Evaluate whether sparse query pretraining on nuScenes unlabeled data helps detectors trained on other datasets. Pretrain Sparse4Dv3 with a ResNet-101 backbone for 40 epochs with a rendering objective on all nuScenes frames, then fine-tune on Waymo and Argoverse 2 with 10 percent and 100 percent of labels for 24 epochs. Report mAP on each target and on nuScenes after fine-tuning on the other two.
CONTROLS: ImageNet initialization, pretraining directly on the target dataset's unlabeled frames, and pretraining on nuScenes with a camera-intrinsics randomization step, to separate geometry learning from dataset-specific cues. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 1500
PREDICTION: Expected cross-dataset gain of 1 to 2 mAP points at 10 percent labels, about half of the in-domain gain. It could fail if camera layout differences make the pretrained queries misaligned on Waymo.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Camera intrinsics randomization in pretraining of sparse queries for Waymo and Argoverse 2
PROPOSAL: Pretrain Sparse4Dv3 with a ResNet-101 backbone on unlabeled nuScenes frames with a rendering objective, where camera intrinsics are perturbed during pretraining at 4 strengths. Each strength is pretrained for 30 epochs and then fine-tuned on Waymo and Argoverse 2 with 10 percent of labels for 24 epochs, which gives four pretrainings and eight fine-tuning runs.
CONTROLS: ImageNet initialization, pretraining without perturbation, and a plot of mAP against perturbation strength for each target dataset with confidence intervals, plus the same plot restricted to the front camera alone. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 1500
PREDICTION: Expected a modest perturbation to help by about 0.5 mAP over none, with all settings above ImageNet initialization. It could fail if the effect is smaller than seed variance.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Query-level contrastive pretraining with temporal positives for sparse detection
PROPOSAL: Pretrain PETRv2 with a ResNet-50 backbone on unlabeled nuScenes using a contrastive loss between queries: the query that attends to a scene location at frame t is a positive of the query attending to the same location, ego-motion corrected, at frame t+2, and queries from other locations are negatives. Pretraining runs 20 epochs on a quarter of the unlabeled scenes; fine-tuning runs 12 epochs on 10 percent of box labels.
CONTROLS: ImageNet initialization, image-level contrastive backbone pretraining of the same duration, and a variant without the ego-motion correction so that the pairing is merely nearby in the image. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 300
PREDICTION: Expected mAP gain of about 1.2 points over ImageNet initialization. It could fail if queries from empty space dominate the negatives and the loss learns background rather than objects.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Contrastive pretraining of sparse detectors with negative-count and temperature choices
PROPOSAL: Pretrain PETRv2 with a ResNet-50 backbone on unlabeled nuScenes using a contrastive loss between queries that attend to the same scene location, ego-motion corrected, at frames t and t+2. The negative count takes 5 levels and the temperature four values, and each pairing is pretrained for 6 epochs on an eighth of the unlabeled scenes and fine-tuned for 12 epochs on 10 percent of box labels.
CONTROLS: ImageNet initialization, image-level contrastive backbone pretraining of the same duration, and a heat map of mAP over negative count and temperature with intervals computed across the pairings. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 300
PREDICTION: Expected a broad plateau, with mAP varying by under 0.4 points over most pairings and about 1.2 points above ImageNet initialization. It could fail if low temperatures collapse training in one corner of the plateau.
